source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Nursing staff working alone, without routine input from social work, case management, or other disciplines","B":"An interdisciplinary team, including nursing, social work, case management, and other relevant disciplines","C":"The billing department primarily, with limited involvement expected from clinical care disciplines","D":"Only the attending physician, without routine input from other members of the care team"}}
source_row.rationale: Effective discharge planning involves an interdisciplinary team, including nursing, social work, case management, and other relevant disciplines, to address the client's full range of post-discharge needs.
source_row.source_name: CMS Conditions of Participation — Discharge Planning Standards
